title: IA3 Mirror activation views
hypothesis: Task-specific Givens activation Views on a shared nonlinear feature network outperform IA3 diagonal task scaling in quality-per-byte on held-out task regression.
physical_object: Shared 16x16 tanh hidden network and shared readout
mirror_coordinate: Task-specific four-angle block Givens hidden activation transform

task.metric: mean and worst task held-out MSE

controls: IA3 hidden-channel task scales with shared output readout
Mirror Givens hidden views with shared readout

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, bytes <=65% independent, and >=10% better MSE than IA3 at byte-near cost (within 15%) or lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses gate or IA3 matches at equal/lower bytes.
protocol_variant_note: A separate post-fit linear activation-scale orbit screen is retained under protocol_variants/postfit_linear_scale_orbit; it missed its 20% byte gate and metrics are not pooled.
